name: Manifest schema version
symptom: A manifest declared as v1.0 that uses WebSearch.sites and CodeInterpreter is flagged by schema validation or the app package validation step (observe and record exact messages)
cause: Capabilities and properties are added per schema version; v1.8 is current and a manifest may only use what its declared version supports
fix: Keep $schema and version in step at v1.8; read each schema page's changes section when upgrading old manifests

name: OpenAPI constraints (broken spec)
symptom: Operation without operationId missing or flagged in the Agents Toolkit picker; oneOf and nested request objects flagged or unusable; API returns 400 NESTED_VALUE_NOT_SUPPORTED or MISSING_FIELD (observe and record)
cause: Nested request objects, oneOf/allOf/anyOf and circular references are unsupported; operationId is required
fix: Use the compliant openapi.yaml: add operationId, flatten request bodies, page list responses

name: Plugin response limits (items, tokens, timeout)
symptom: customer-lookup with pageSize=200 gives a partial, truncated or failed answer; delayMs=60000 makes the call time out (observe and record); no KB or MB limit documented
cause: Plugin responses are limited to 25 items, 4,096 tokens and a 45-second timeout; byte limit undocumented
fix: Keep page sizes small, return totals, instruct the agent never to request more than 25 items, add summary endpoints, keep calls well under 45 seconds

name: Sideloading (custom app upload) policy
symptom: Accounts pane loses Custom App Upload Enabled; Provision fails at the sideload step and the agent never appears in Copilot (observe and record)
cause: Custom app upload is turned off in the Teams setup policy assigned to the user
fix: Assign a setup policy with Upload custom apps on (or use a developer tenant), wait for it to apply, sign in again and provision

name: Capability scoping by URL
symptom: Agent cannot answer from Finance or Getting-Started documents the user can open; removing items_by_url makes those answers appear; with more than 20 files in scope details can be missed
cause: items_by_url limits grounding to the listed URLs; omitting scope means all accessible content; full-content search covers only the 20 most relevant files
fix: Scope every library the agent needs and nothing else; reference 20 or fewer specific files when precision matters

name: API key in custom header vs bearer
symptom: With the X-API-Key header scheme the call either succeeds or the API logs 401 UNAUTHORIZED depending on tenant behavior (observe and record); switching to type http scheme bearer succeeds
cause: Learn sources conflict: API key page supports custom headers, known issues page says custom headers are not supported
fix: Prefer the bearer scheme for API keys when you control the API; keep a bearer fallback
